title: JD Vance top opposition
follower_snapshot_pt: November 18, 2026, Pacific Time, from X public metrics on accounts that were opened
ranking_method: Ranked by reach and frequency. Score = rank_reach × (1 + 0.25 × (critical_items − 1)). rank_reach is the opened X follower count, except for CUFI Action Fund, where rank_reach is the parent @CUFI follower count (56,979), which is disclosed in that entry. Ties break by raw followers, then name.

side_labels.right: Conservative or Republican-aligned officials, commentators, and outlets
side_labels.left: Democratic or liberal-aligned officials and commentators
side_labels.institutional: Organizations or newspapers that are not primarily a U.S. party office (used here for ADL and The Jerusalem Post)
side_labels.unspecified: Used only when the account bio and opened posts do not state a partisan identity (FactPost)

sources.a: Authors of critical items already in entries.json
sources.b: Prominent accounts in replies and quote-posts under those items, including the Matt Walsh poll thread of November 17–18, 2026
sources.c: A fresh X and web search for high-reach Vance critics on the right and the left

exclusions: Matt Walsh is not listed. His November 17 thread asked about 'raw political talent' and included Vance in a poll; he did not attack Vance. The thread is in the tracker as mixed.

Tomi Lahren (@TomiLahren, 2,865,615 followers) commented in the Walsh thread that she wanted someone who 'stays true to the values' and named Ron DeSantis. That is a preference, not a critique of Vance, so she is not listed.
Sen. Tom Cotton was described in Jewish Insider as taking a 'veiled swipe' at Vance over Iran policy without naming him. Because the opened reporting says he did not name Vance, he is not listed.
Ryan Schmelz of Fox News reported Fine's comments; he is a correspondent, not a critic, and his account is under the follower threshold.

News outlets that only reported criticism (Fox News news article, JTA news reports, Jewish Insider news reports) are not listed as critics. Signed editorials, signed columns, and organizational statements are.
This list is not exhaustive. A missing name is not a finding that the person is not a critic.

opponents.name: Mark R. Levin
opponents.affiliation: Host of The Mark Levin Show; Liberty's Voice (from his X bio).
main_criticisms: Called an Iran-related agreement 'a disaster,' saying it was 'negotiated by VP Vance, promoted by VP Vance,' and adding 'Notice you don't defend it.'
Said the 2028 Republican primary is likely to be more competitive than some think, and that Tucker Carlson 'will undoubtedly be a toxic and controversial issue tied to Vance.'
opponents.last_seen_pt: November 15, 2026 (date of the later opened X post; time not re-fetched this update)

opponents.name: Ted Cruz
opponents.affiliation: U.S. Senator (R-Texas). Official Senate account, government-verified on X.
main_criticisms: At the Tikvah Fund's Jewish Leadership Conference in Manhattan, rejected the idea that the midterms were 'a mandate to abandon Israel,' saying that is something he 'certainly' does not see or agree with.
Told Jewish Insider that Vance 'is welcome to have his own opinion. Mine on this question is quite different, and I have made it public for a long, long time.'

opponents.name: Bill O'Reilly
opponents.affiliation: Host associated with No Spin News (from his X bio). The comments below were made as a guest on Sid & Friends in the Morning on 77 WABC.
main_criticisms: On the November 7, 2026 episode of Sid & Friends in the Morning, said he saw 'a bit of opportunism' in Vance's midterm postmortem and that Vance was starting to signal he would run and 'I'm not the same guy Trump is, because you guys don't like Trump anymore.' O'Reilly said he did not like 'that aspect of politics' and 'would never do it myself.'
After co-host Sid Rosenberg called Vance 'so disloyal,' O'Reilly added, 'That's what they call a character deficit,' and said every politician has one.

opponents.name: Anti-Defamation League (ADL)
opponents.affiliation: Advocacy organization whose X bio states its purpose is 'to stop the defamation of the Jewish people, and secure justice and fair treatment to all.'
main_criticisms: Posted that debate over foreign policy and the midterms is 'entirely legitimate,' but that only 4% of voters rated foreign policy as their primary concern. 'When leaders like Vice President JD Vance and commentators ignore the data and instead choose to assert that voter behavior was about Israel, it's not just a deeply flawed analysis but can be weaponized to assign collective blame to Jewish Americans for policy decisions or political outcomes.'
opponents.last_seen_pt: November 5, 2026, 2:04 PM PT
opponents.source_notes: The same statement was quoted in a Jewish Insider report opened for this update. Side is labeled institutional because ADL is an advocacy group, not a party office.

opponents.name: Josh Hammer
opponents.affiliation: Senior counsel at the Article III Project; Shillman Fellow at the Horowitz Center; syndicated columnist and author (from his X bio). The November 16 column ran in FrontPage Magazine.

His FrontPage Magazine column, 'JD Vance Scapegoats the Jews,' argued that Vance's post-election claims about the Iran war and the U.S.-Israel relationship amounted to blaming Jews or Israel.
On November 4 he wrote that 'the single biggest loser from last night's massacre is JD Vance.'
opponents.last_seen_pt: November 16, 2026, 12:38 PM PT (from the tracker entry)
opponents.source_notes: Author of two critical X posts and one column already in the tracker. Follower count from X public metrics on November 18, 2026.

opponents.name: Randy Fine
opponents.affiliation: U.S. Representative (R-Florida, 6th District); member of the House Freedom Caucus (from his official X bio). Personal campaign account @VoteRandyFine (42,974 followers) was also opened; the official account is used here.
main_criticisms: Said he will not endorse Vance in the 2028 primary. Told the Jerusalem Post that 'JD Vance is the reason that the war in Iran is not over because he led us astray in claiming that we could do a peace deal,' and that he found Vance's comments 'a betrayal of the president.'

opponents.name: The Wall Street Journal Editorial Board
opponents.affiliation: Opinion and commentary from The Wall Street Journal (from the @WSJopinion bio). The critic is the editorial board, not a single signed columnist.
main_criticisms: An editorial titled "JD Vance's Theory of Election Defeat" said that by blaming the midterm loss on the Iran war in public, 'Mr. Vance signals desperation to Iran's regime, undermining his boss at a critical moment in the war.'

It said 'it's hard to see how Mr. Vance can credibly continue as America's lead negotiator with the Iranians,' and criticized his call to 'change our relationship to Israel' and his association with Tucker Carlson.

opponents.name: Marc Thiessen
opponents.affiliation: American Enterprise Institute; Fox News; The Washington Post; host of the 'What The Hell Is Going On?' podcast (from his X bio).
main_criticisms: In a Washington Post op-ed titled "JD Vance's stunning act of disloyalty," argued Republicans lost in part because the Iran war dragged on and that 'the vice president owns that.'

On X, wrote that if Vance cannot say Trump made the right decision to disarm Iran, he has no business seeking the 2028 nomination, and that if Vance can't endorse Trump's national security policy, Trump should not endorse him.
On Fox News's Special Report, told Bret Baier he was 'shocked' by Vance's statement and that it was 'quite frankly, disloyal to the president of the United States.'

opponents.name: Sid Rosenberg
opponents.affiliation: Host of Sid & Friends in the Morning on 77 WABC; member of the U.S. Holocaust Memorial Council (from his X bio). Included because of the radio affiliation and council post, even though he is under the 50,000-follower threshold. An older account, @sidrosenberg (39,925 followers, unverified), was also opened and is not counted separately.
main_criticisms: On November 4 wrote that he 'could never vote for this guy for President,' after Vance listed the war and Israel among reasons for the midterm loss, and said he never thought he would see the day Trump would 'allow anyone in his administration to undermine him.'

On November 5 told Vance, 'YOU are the reason why the Iran War is still an issue,' called him a 'Tucker Carlson loving jackass,' urged that Rubio take over the Iran file, and wrote: 'Vance is a disloyal, agenda driven problem for our party moving forward!'
On 77 WABC with Bill O'Reilly, said 'JD Vance calling out Trump is funny because, it was his MOU that has this war going on an extra three months,' and later, 'That's so disloyal!'
opponents.last_seen_pt: November 7, 2026 (77 WABC appearance reported by Mediaite); latest opened X post is November 5, 2026, 7:20 AM PT
